issue_title: Lens names are interpolated into SVG with no XML escaping
issue_body:
**File:** `src/export_formats.py:378, 499, 537`; `src/io/export.py:44, 164, 186, 318, 350`

```python
f'  <text x="{width/2}" y="25" class="title" text-anchor="middle">{lens.name}</text>\n'
```

`validate_lens_name` (`validation.py:491-515`) accepts any string ≤100 chars, and names arrive from
untrusted JSON. There is **no** `escape`/`html.escape` call anywhere in `src/`.

**Repro (verified):** `Lens(name='</text><script>alert(1)</script>')` exported to SVG:
```
raw <script> in SVG: True
SVG parses as XML: False -> mismatched tag: line 16, column 94
```

The file is both **script-bearing** when opened in a browser and structurally invalid XML — a plain
`&` in a name is enough to break the latter.

**Fix:** `from xml.sax.saxutils import escape` and wrap every interpolated name/material.
pr_title: fix(export): escape names and materials interpolated into SVG
pr_body:
Closes #309

## Problem

Lens and system names come from **untrusted JSON** — `validate_lens_name` accepts any string up to 100 chars — and were interpolated straight into SVG text nodes. There was no `escape`/`html.escape` call anywhere in `src/`.

A name of `'</text><script>alert(1)</script>'` produced a file that was **both** script-bearing when opened in a browser **and** structurally invalid XML:

```
raw <script> in SVG: True
SVG parses as XML: False -> mismatched tag: line 16, column 94
```

A plain `&` in a name was enough to break the XML on its own, with no injection at all.

## Fix

Eight sites now pass through `xml.sax.saxutils.escape`:

- **`SVGExporter`** — lens title, system title, material label
- **`ISO10110Generator`** — drawing title, title-block row values, material column, both coating labels

The title-block case escapes the whole row value, so future rows are covered by construction rather than by remembering.

The non-SVG writers (STL comments, prescription text) are deliberately left alone: they are not XML, so escaping there would corrupt the output.

## Verified

Across script, ampersand and unicode payloads on both generators:

```
'</text><script>  export_lens  script:False parses:True
'</text><script>  ISO10110    script:False parses:True
'R&D x <b> & '   export_lens  script:False parses:True
'R&D x <b> & '   ISO10110    script:False parses:True
'Ø 25mm ünïcode'   export_lens  script:False parses:True
```

The escaped text also **round-trips to the original string** through the parser — this is lossless escaping, not lossy sanitisation.

## Tests

16 tests, **10 fail without the change**: script injection, well-formedness, lossless round-tripping, and that an ordinary name is not mangled (no double-escaping).

## Note

`SVGExporter.export_system` crashes on `LensElement.air_gap_before`, which does not exist. That is a separate defect — tracked as #295.
